records.name: Dokki
records.community_evidence: The durable card explicitly says Built with OpenClaw.
records.current_gate: Declared no-auth transport redirects to login; independent task conformance is 405.

status_notes: Returning errors when contacted by users
registry_conformance.maintainer_note: A2A endpoint returns 405 and must accept POST message/send.

fleethelp_contract.actual_access: Subscription at 99 USD/month per organization; support delivered through Telegram, with paid message packs and VIP tier.
fleethelp_contract.openclaw_relationship: FleetHelp advertises deep OpenClaw expertise and multi-framework support. It does not claim to be built with OpenClaw or publish a durable OpenClaw platform identity.

strict_decision.reason: FleetHelp is paid, currently non-conformant and only adjacent to OpenClaw by support coverage. Dokki remains the only strongly joined public OpenClaw machine and its transport still fails the declared no-auth contract.
strict_decision.exact_ready_condition: Dokki serves anonymous current A2A message/send and completes one bounded research task using AG, or another pre-existing identity proves actual OpenClaw runtime membership and exposes a healthy free bounded AG-consuming operation.
